rows.needed: A(Q) tensor Q2 injects into continuous H1(Q,V2A).

sources.part: finite Kummer injection and cocycle construction

rows.argument: Split the finitely generated group M=A(Q) as a free summand F plus its finite torsion subgroup. The natural identification F tensor Q2 = M tensor Q2 removes the torsion. Choose compatible division points for an integral basis of F. Their Kummer cocycles extend Z2-linearly to the free completion F tensor Z2, giving continuous T2A-valued cocycles. If a cocycle from this free completion becomes a coboundary in V2A, multiply its witness by a fixed power 2^s to put it in T2A. At every finite level the resulting Kummer class is zero, so finite Kummer injectivity gives that 2^s times the completed free point has zero image in M/2^nM for every n. Since F is a direct summand, its image is zero in F/2^nF for every n, hence it is zero in F tensor Z2. After tensoring Q2 this proves the claimed injection. This construction does not assert a Z2-linear lift of the torsion completion into T2A-valued cocycles and makes no finiteness assumption on Sha.
incoming: Mordell-Weil finite generation; finite Kummer injection; compatible division points from surjectivity of multiplication.
